author: (R. B. Watson, 1879)

note.en: A tiny tusk shell, about 1 cm, that lives buried in sand; one INBio specimen at Punta Cahuita (8 m, 1998). Seen only as empty shells.
note.es: Un colmillo de mar diminuto, de cerca de 1 cm, que vive enterrado en la arena; un ejemplar de INBio en Punta Cahuita (8 m, 1998). Solo se ven conchas vacías.

evidence: GBIF: 1 INBio specimen (1998), Punta Cahuita, 8 m

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (INBio specimens and others), Gandoca to Limón

recWhy: Recorded: GBIF: 1 INBio specimen[^3], Punta Cahuita, 8 m.

marks.en: Slim curved tube-like tusk shell, white, open at both ends.
marks.es: Concha tubular, delgada y curva, blanca, abierta en ambos extremos.
